description: A confirmation checkbox to acknowledge that closing the account and deleting data will result in the permanent loss of all content and purchases, which cannot be restored.

Deleting your account is permanent. When you delete your account, your main profile and everything else you've added will be permanently deleted. You won't be able to retrieve anything you've added. All additional profiles, Messenger and all of your messages will also be deleted.

Once you delete your account, your profile and username are permanently removed from Reddit and your posts, comments, and messages are disassociated (not deleted) from your account unless you delete them beforehand.

This will deactivate your account. You're about to start the process of deactivating your X account. Your display name, @username, and public profile will no longer be viewable on X.com, X for iOS, or X for Android. You can restore your X account if it was accidentally or wrongfully deactivated for up to 30 days after deactivation.
